families.share: h2..6, total2h4..12, choice half; source groupArt. Distractors whole and h±1, per-candidate reasons.
families.deal: h2..6, constructive deal task n2h, side buttons and undo; native finite pile; explanation h+h=2h.
families.fair: h2..5; equal h/h or unequal(h+1)/(h−1), YESNO; count/compare each share.
families.number: h2..10, half of4..20, one/two ten-frames; choice h and distinct wrong values via pickNum/alts.
families.transfer: h3..8 known one half; reconstruct whole2h6..16. Optional reverse/composition bridge, not a new hard addition/doubling gate.

actualInventory.media: Read complete dealScene/evenOut+sideRows/sides, real anim/ease wrapper; no imported mascot vectors will be copied. Future mathematical objects use original geometry and unchanged shared PNGs only.
actualInventory.feedback: Meaningful whole-vs-half and ±1 reasons; fair distinguishes quantities. pickNum filters correct/duplicate distractors; raw deal checker overuse boundary noted.
actualInventory.registry: Explicit node goal; cases selects share/deal/fair/number in normal phases; transfer separate. No own family/coverage override or SIMS overlay. Audit correction includes deal; COVERAGE table omits it and has stale global revision.
